aboutHtml: I am a quality engineering professional with nearly four years of experience assuring mission-critical banking and payment security technology for central banks and government clients across four continents. I currently serve as Test Lead for a Central Bank Digital Currency (CBDC) client in Malawi and as Senior Automation SDET for a Hardware Security Module (HSM) product at IDEMIA.

My work sits where business risk meets engineering detail: owning test strategy, entry and exit criteria, regression and non-regression cycles, and the release-readiness reporting that clients rely on for go/no-go decisions. I am hands-on in Python, Selenium and Jenkins CI/CD, built our test framework from TDD to BDD, and mentor new QA engineers so teams can deliver independently.

featured.title: SDET Automation Framework
featured.text: BDD UI and API test automation across a storefront, an online bank (ParaBank), two REST APIs and an OWASP-aligned security suite, running on every change and nightly in GitHub Actions. Each run publishes a release-readiness report with exit criteria, open defects and a Go / No-go recommendation.
